author: Kif Leswing
title: Bringing iPhone apps to the Mac won't stop its slow march to the grave - the future is the smartphone (AAPL)
text: Bringing iPhone apps to the Mac won't stop its slow march to the grave — the future is the smartphone (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Jun 5, 2018, 8:34 am 23 pts Apple announced plans on Monday to release software in 2019 that would let iPhone apps run on Mac computers. The announcement was supposed to generate interest in the Mac software marketplace, but it only confirms the desktop's second-place status to the smartphone. Apple sold over 12 times as many…
